server.name: Airefs
server.title: Airefs AI Visibility
server.description: Read Airefs data to analyze brand visibility in ChatGPT and Google AI Overview, inspect prompts and citations, compare competitors, and identify content and backlink opportunities.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Airefs measures how visible a brand is in AI answers and turns that into levers, each with a product surface: (1) publish the evidence-backed article recommendations (Articles page — list_article_recommendations ranks the content gaps by citation evidence, which is not the order the page writes in; list_scheduled_content is the queue actually being written); (2) join the discussions AI already cites (Sources page — list_source_urls with citation_type "Discussion" for the threads already cited; Discussions page — list_discussion_threads for the Reddit Alerts keyword matches; get_discussion_mentions for scan state); (3) earn citations on the third-party domains AI already trusts (Backlinks page — list_backlink_opportunities for the domains to pursue; list_source_domains for the unfiltered citation evidence; list_backlink_statuses for outreach state). For a full prioritized plan, run the airefs_action_plan prompt; per-page docs are under get_doc. List tools return one page: page_row_count is the page size, never a population total. Cite total_count where a tool returns it — when total_count_is_capped is true it is a lower bound, so report it as "at least" that many — otherwise page through cursor while has_more is true before claiming a total (get_prompt_inventory_summary reports prompt totals).
